description: She wears a cream ivory subtly patterned opaque floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and loose elbow-length sleeves. Burgundy-and-gold floral woven borders frame the neckline, bodice seams, skirt front opening, sleeve ends and hem. Round gold brooches sit at the neckline sides. A broad burgundy wrap with gold motifs and edging falls loosely around her forearms and hangs down both sides. A decorated gold-and-brown girdle has a large round gold buckle and long embroidered hanging ends. A fine necklace with a round pendant, earrings and a wrist bracelet accompany the dress. One tan-gold patterned closed-toe shoe shows beneath the opening; no headgear or weapon is visible.
